platform-syscall-present.description: The current source emits System.Contract.CallWithGasLimit for both verifier callbacks (DEC-AA-1). Published neoxp registers no such interop, so every verifier-signed operation must fault; the proxy-witness path without a verifier must still work.

scenarios.name: SRC-01/02 current source core: build profile and native-owner execution
checks: the source variant deploys freshly compiled bytes, not the pinned deployed artifact
the compiled source core emits System.Contract.CallWithGasLimit for both verifier callbacks
backup owner recorded
no verifier: native fallback
native-witness operation HALTed and advanced the nonce

scenarios.name: SRC-03 current source core: proxy witness without a verifier
checks: proxy address holds 10 GAS
scope target recorded
the proxy-witness operation HALTed and moved the signed amount
buyer received exactly 1 GAS from the AA proxy address
proxy address paid exactly 1 GAS; the owner wallet paid the fees
nonce advanced
proxy rules naming another asset are still refused by the node

scenarios.name: SRC-04 current source core: verifier callback (validateSignature)
checks: DEC-AA-1 expected fault: the verifier-signed operation faults on a published node
the fault names the unregistered interop 1371299780
the fault left the account nonce unconsumed

scenarios.name: SRC-03b current source core: verifier-backed proxy witness (P-256)
checks: DEC-AA-1 expected fault: the verifier-backed proxy-witness operation faults on a published node
the fault names the unregistered interop 1371299780
no GAS moved and the nonce is unchanged

scenarios.name: SRC-09 current source relay: proxy GAS and sponsored refusal
checks: public-node relay proof is unavailable for the private-syscall profile

scenarios.name: SRC-08 current source sponsorship: shared transaction fee cap
checks: the complete two-entrypoint sponsored script prices with a fee between its partial and total requests
one signed transaction HALTs both sponsored entrypoints and emits two reimbursements
the second reimbursement receives only the first invocation's unused transaction fee budget
aggregate reimbursement equals actual transaction fees and cannot repay them twice
sponsor debit equals actual fees and the relay is made whole without profit
single-plus-batch sponsorship advances the account nonce exactly twice
the signed persisted sponsored transaction uses the complete script that was estimated

scenarios.name: SRC-10 current source recovery: permanent callback-free owner-only
checks: recovery account has a verifier and hook before owner-only recovery
premature owner-only recovery faults and changes no account or asset state
chain maturity and old hook core mismatch are read back
ordinary cleanup failure rolls back verifier cleanup, pointers, nonce and assets
signed owner-only finalization HALTs and emits its recovery-mode event
mode query confirms permanent owner-only state with no active modules or escape
recovery preserves backup owner, account proxy, nonce and all observed assets
callback-free recovery leaves old verifier storage untouched instead of invoking cleanup
backup-owner witness executes without the detached verifier and hook
the recovered proxy witness transfers exactly one GAS and advances the original nonce cursor
permanent owner-only mode refuses both verifier and hook reinstallation without state changes
a stranger still cannot execute or advance the recovered account nonce

platform-syscall-absent.description: The public build profile landed (CU-29 / DEC-AA-1): the compiled core emits no gas-bounded verifier callback, so the same verifier-signed and verifier-backed proxy-witness operations must execute on published neoxp.
